rationale: Actual Target quantifies all m,n with 5<=m, Odd m and 2<=n. It then chooses an actual multivariate polynomial on all m(n-1)+1 Hankel coefficients and explicitly witnesses a nonzero evaluation before imposing the equality at every point of its nonvanishing locus.

The imported TR14 HankelIndex uses the complete zero-based index sum, with a proved bound m(n-1)+1. Its Hankel, OrdinaryWidth and SymmetricWidth definitions were reread. They are full complex sums of arbitrary products and complex scalar multiples of pure powers, respectively, with no hidden rank predicates.

VandermondeVector has entries a^(n-1-i)*b^i for every Fin n index. Natural subtraction does not underflow on this range. The nonzero-pair disjunction retains the points a=0 or b=0 individually, including the point at infinity; coefficients may vanish.

OrdinaryBorderWidth uses a sequence of arbitrary ambient tensors, not symmetric or Hankel tensors. SymmetricBorderWidth constrains each approximant only by a symmetric width decomposition, not a Hankel or Vandermonde restriction. Both limits are every-coordinate convergence in the usual complex topology.

EqualFiveRanks includes all four equivalences against OrdinaryWidth at every natural width r, including r=0. Zero padding makes each predicate upward closed. Ordinary/symmetric/Vandermonde finite decompositions exist for Hankel tensors, and constant approximating sequences give finite border upper bounds, so these all-width equivalences match equality of all five minima.

The actual polynomial evaluation is the ring-homomorphism evaluation from the pinned MvPolynomial API. Its nonzero locus is a principal affine Zariski open; existence of a witnessed nonempty principal open is equivalent to existence of some nonempty open satisfying the original property.

No explicit generic-rank value was added, since that is background rather than an additional subquestion. Conversely no rank equality, projective endpoint, odd order or full generic coefficient domain was omitted.

Complete original/specification and implementation notes were compared to the actual source. The frozen copy is mechanically identical except the documented leading comment and namespace rename. The hash bindings include the transitive local source closure, pins and notes.

The source defines, rather than proves, Target. Global kernel trust and both statement/trust assertions are present. The retained pinned macOS live/frozen logs report the standard three axioms; the author-local root receipt reports exit zero for these modules and rfl identity checks. This reviewer inspected those records but did not independently rerun Lean or Linux Comparator.

It approves mathematical/model correspondence of the exact definition bytes, not the truth of the catalog problem. Author-local root compile receipts were inspected as evidence; no independent execution or Linux Comparator pass is asserted here.
